title: Deva
desc: Deva and Bharathi are in love and plan on getting married until her father opposes their relationship. Can Deva prove himself to be a worthy suitor?

title: Rajadurai
desc: Rajadurai, a police officer, succeeds in capturing Mayandi, a gangster, and sending him to jail. Later, Mayandi kidnaps Rajadurai's son, Vijay, and raises him as a criminal.

title: Agadu
desc: When four friends embark on a trip to hill station, they meet a father-daughter duo. However, things take a turn when one of the friends is found dead and the little girl goes missing.

title: Maayavi
desc: Abhes, a con man, kidnaps famous actress Jyothika in an act of revenge after she sends him to prison. As her family searches for her, Jyothika comes to understand Abhes' true character.
